description: Search Agency Standings. Each result includes its industry, services, evidence level, a one-line evidence summary, profile URL, and contact URL. A plain-language query drops filler words such as agency, firm, best, and top, maps words such as lawyer, Shopify, or software onto an industry, and ranks agencies that match any remaining word. If a location matches nobody, that location is left off and the response includes a note. Ecom, Legal, SaaS, Finance, and Service include rank numbers. Agencies without enough evidence stay unranked and have no rank number. A service, location, or zip filter numbers the matches from 1 in the existing industry order. get_agency keeps each agency's industry rank. Results do not include a numeric score.

industry.description: Industry slug or label, such as ecom or Legal.

limit.description: Maximum results to return. Defaults to 10.

location.description: City, state, or country. Matches state abbreviations and full names, cities, and country names against a sourced headquarters or other listed office.

query.description: Plain language or words matched against the name, services, and evidence summary. Filler words are ignored.

service.description: Service slug or label, such as seo or Web Design.

user_request.description: A short paraphrase of what the user is looking for, in their words (no personal or sensitive info).

zip.description: Postal code matched against a stored headquarters string.

name: search_agencies
title: Search agencies
